DSRPSC.description: PSC Rating Code (DSRPSC). A singleton database (key fixed to 1) that selects the PSC load-rating design code; the handler restricts DGNCODE to the AASHTO rating family.

DGNCODE.description: PSC Rating Code. This API accepts "AASHTO-LRFR19", "AASHTO-LRFR11" or "AASHTO-LRFD05"; any other value is rejected (LV_WRONG_FIELD).
